51614884.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to PRMT4 (unknown origin) assessed as dissociation constant by ITC analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - ITC Measurements: Isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) experiments were performed to assess compounds 55 and 56 binding affinities with PRMT4. For compound 56, ITC measurements were conducted on a MicroCal ITC200 (Malvern Instruments) at 25 °C. 56 was diluted to 200 μM in 100 mM HEPES pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.005% Tween-20 (HBS-EP) buffer with a final DMSO concentration of 1%. The sample cell containing 20 μM PRMT4 in HBS-EP buffer with a final DMSO concentration of 1% was injected with 20 μL aliquots of 200 μM 56. The experiment was performed in triplicate.

For compound 55, ITC measurements were conducted on an Affinity ITC (TA Instruments) at 25 °C. 55 was diluted to 200 μM in HBS-EP buffer with a final DMSO concentration of 1% and was injected into the sample cell containing 20 μM PRMT4 in HBS-EP buffer with a final DMSO concentration of 1%. The experiment was performed in triplicate and binding constants were calculated by fitting the data using independent model analysis in NanoAnalyze software (Supplementary Table ST9).
original_paragraph.Figure 7 caption: Fig. 7. PRMT4 binding confirmation of 56 and 55. Isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) was used to confirm binding of (A) 56 and (B) 55 to PRMT4. 56 showed binding with a Kd of 20 ± 9 μM and 55 with a Kd of 25 ± 6 μM.
original_paragraph.Results - Binding experiment (ITC): Since both compounds 55 and 56 showed excellent potency against PRMT4, (IC50 92 ± 41 and 37 ± 3 nM, respectively) their binding to the protein was further confirmed through isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC). ITC experiment provided a dissociation constant of 25 ± 6 μM for compound 55 against PRMT4 (Fig. 7), along with other thermodynamic properties which revealed a favorable change in enthalpy and an unfavorable change in entropy. The binding of compounds 55 and 56 to PRMT4 is thus an enthalpy-driven process indicative of polar and hydrophobic interactions. Compound 56 also showed reproducible binding to PRMT4 with a Kd value of 20 ± 9 μM (Fig. 7) Supplementary Table ST9.

assay_conditions.buffer_composition: 100 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.005% Tween-20
